sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games. Sandbach will be looking to maintain their push at the summit against opposition in poor form.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town, looking to bounce back from their most recent draw and stay in contention with the leaders. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have lost their last outing; Bridgnorth themselves are seeking to recover from a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash. In-form Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir, while Barnton (7th) welcome Shawbury United—the latter winless in five games and desperate for a turnaround. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two sides struggling in the lower half; Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, the division's bottom club on just 2 points from 7 games. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a clash between two struggling sides near the relegation zone.
